mapper.sql: CASE WHEN t.task_name LIKE '基线复检-%' OR t.task_name LIKE '修复后自动复检-%' OR t.task_name LIKE '主机即时检测-%' THEN 'RECHECK' ELSE 'SCAN' END
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS id, t.task_name AS taskName, t.execute_type AS executeType, AS taskType, COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(t.rule_scope, '$.ruleIds')), 0) AS ruleCount, t.total_host_count AS hostCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_task_host th WHERE th.task_id = t.id AND th.status = 'FINISHED') AS finishedHostCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.compliance_rate), 2) FROM baseline_summary s WHERE s.task_id = t.id) AS avgPassRate, t.status AS status, t.create_time AS createTime FROM baseline_task t WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_task t WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.total_host_count AS totalHostCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_task_host h WHERE h.task_id = t.id AND h.status = 'FINISHED') AS finishedHostCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.compliance_rate), 2) FROM baseline_summary s WHERE s.task_id = t.id) AS avgComplianceRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r.host_id FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY r.host_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) problem_hosts) AS failHostCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.rule_id) FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR')) AS problemRuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.status = 'PASS') AS passRuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.status = 'FAIL') AS failRuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.status = 'ERROR') AS errorRuleCount FROM baseline_task t WHERE t.id = #{taskId}

SELECT agg.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, agg.complianceRate AS complianceRate, agg.passRuleCount AS passRuleCount, agg.failRuleCount AS failRuleCount, agg.errorRuleCount AS errorRuleCount FROM ( SELECT r.host_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS complianceRate, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passRuleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failRuleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errorRuleCount FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY r.host_id ) agg LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = agg.host_id ORDER BY (agg.failRuleCount + agg.errorRuleCount) DESC, agg.host_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r.host_id FROM baseline_result r WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY r.host_id ) agg

SELECT r.id AS resultId, r.rule_id AS ruleId, ru.rule_name AS ruleName, ru.category AS category, r.check_key AS checkKey, r.expected_value AS expectedValue, r.actual_value AS actualValue, COALESCE(r.evidence, r.message) AS evidence, r.status AS status, ru.remediation_type AS remediationType, r.remediation_status AS remediationStatus, r.scan_time AS scanTime FROM baseline_result r LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = r.rule_id WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.host_id = #{hostId} ORDER BY r.rule_id ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT r.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, h.os_name AS osName, r.rule_id AS ruleId, ru.rule_name AS ruleName, ru.category AS category, ru.severity AS severity, r.check_key AS checkKey, r.status AS status, r.remediation_status AS remediationStatus, (SELECT w.status FROM baseline_workorder w WHERE w.result_id = r.id ORDER BY w.update_time DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS workorderStatus, r.expected_value AS expectedValue, r.actual_value AS actualValue, r.evidence AS evidence, r.scan_time AS scanTime FROM baseline_result r LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = r.host_id LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = r.rule_id WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY r.host_id ASC, r.rule_id ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT r.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, h.os_name AS osName, r.rule_id AS ruleId, ru.rule_name AS ruleName, ru.category AS category, ru.severity AS severity, r.check_key AS checkKey, r.status AS status, r.remediation_status AS remediationStatus, (SELECT w.status FROM baseline_workorder w WHERE w.result_id = r.id ORDER BY w.update_time DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS workorderStatus, r.expected_value AS expectedValue, r.actual_value AS actualValue, COALESCE(r.evidence, r.message) AS evidence, r.scan_time AS scanTime FROM baseline_result r LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = r.host_id LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = r.rule_id WHERE r.host_id = #{hostId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM baseline_result newer WHERE newer.host_id = r.host_id AND newer.rule_id = r.rule_id AND COALESCE(newer.check_key, '') = COALESCE(r.check_key, '') AND ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') > COALESCE(r.scan_time, '1970-01-01') OR ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') = COALESCE(r.scan_time, '1970-01-01') AND newer.id > r.id ) ) ) ORDER BY (r.status = 'PASS') ASC, r.rule_id ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT id AS id, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, category AS category, severity AS severity FROM baseline_rule WHERE enabled = 1 AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND (rule_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id ASC

sql.if: AND (h.hostname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.ipv4 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT snap.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, h.os_name AS osName, snap.compliance_rate AS complianceRate, snap.total_count AS totalCount, snap.pass_count AS passCount, snap.fail_count AS failCount, snap.last_scan_time AS lastScanTime, snap.task_id AS taskId FROM ( SELECT latest.host_id, MAX(latest.task_id) AS task_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN latest.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN latest.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN latest.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS compliance_rate, MAX(latest.scan_time) AS last_scan_time FROM baseline_result latest WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM baseline_result newer WHERE newer.host_id = latest.host_id AND newer.rule_id = latest.rule_id AND COALESCE(newer.check_key, '') = COALESCE(latest.check_key, '') AND ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') > COALESCE(latest.scan_time, '1970-01-01') OR ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') = COALESCE(latest.scan_time, '1970-01-01') AND newer.id > latest.id ) ) ) GROUP BY latest.host_id ) snap LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = snap.host_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY snap.compliance_rate ASC, snap.host_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT latest.host_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN latest.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS compliance_rate FROM baseline_result latest WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM baseline_result newer WHERE newer.host_id = latest.host_id AND newer.rule_id = latest.rule_id AND COALESCE(newer.check_key, '') = COALESCE(latest.check_key, '') AND ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') > COALESCE(latest.scan_time, '1970-01-01') OR ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') = COALESCE(latest.scan_time, '1970-01-01') AND newer.id > latest.id ) ) ) GROUP BY latest.host_id ) snap LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = snap.host_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT r.id AS resultId, r.rule_id AS ruleId, ru.rule_name AS ruleName, ru.category AS category, r.check_key AS checkKey, r.expected_value AS expectedValue, r.actual_value AS actualValue, r.evidence AS evidence, r.status AS status, ru.remediation_type AS remediationType, r.remediation_status AS remediationStatus, rem.status AS latestRemediationStatus, rem.remediation_type AS latestRemediationType, rem.operator AS latestRemediationOperator, rem.start_time AS latestRemediationStartTime, rem.end_time AS latestRemediationEndTime, r.scan_time AS scanTime FROM baseline_result r LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = r.rule_id LEFT JOIN baseline_remediation rem ON rem.id = ( SELECT br.id FROM baseline_remediation br LEFT JOIN baseline_result rr ON rr.id = br.result_id WHERE br.host_id = r.host_id AND br.rule_id = r.rule_id AND COALESCE(rr.check_key, '') = COALESCE(r.check_key, '') ORDER BY br.create_time DESC, br.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE r.host_id = #{hostId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM baseline_result newer WHERE newer.host_id = r.host_id AND newer.rule_id = r.rule_id AND COALESCE(newer.check_key, '') = COALESCE(r.check_key, '') AND ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') > COALESCE(r.scan_time, '1970-01-01') OR ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') = COALESCE(r.scan_time, '1970-01-01') AND newer.id > r.id ) ) )
AND r.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR')
ORDER BY (r.status = 'PASS') ASC, r.id ASC
